In the architecture diagram (Figure 1, Step 1, page 6):

- **Aggregated History Embedding:** labelled **"GeM Pooling"**, applied to the Visited Profiles Embeddings (page 6).
- **Aggregated User Embedding:** labelled **"Temporal-Gated Pooling"**, which combines the user-profile embedding with the aggregated history embedding (page 6).

The paper doesn't match its own diagram on the history pooling. The Figure 1 caption says the history tower aggregates recent interactions "using positional attention" (page 6). The text describes the final query embedding as a "normalized additive fusion" of the profile and history embeddings with a learnable weight γ (Eq. 3–4, page 5), not as a temporal-gated pooling. The ablation compares max, mean, GeM, attention and positional-attention pooling. Positional attention scores best, with GeM pooling "followed closely" behind (page 7). So the diagram's "GeM Pooling" label may come from an earlier version of the model rather than the final one.
